name: Order receipt
description: The open order's number, fulfilment and totals.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/order-receipt", name: "Order receipt", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The open order's number, fulfilment and totals.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Order ${options.order.order_number}", weight: FontWeight.bold)), Badge(label: options.order.status, tone: Tone.primary)]),
      Text(child: options.order.fulfilment_type == "delivery" ? "Delivery to ${options.order.delivery_address_line1}" : "Collection from ${options.order.store_name}", color: Color.textMuted),
      Divider(),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Subtotal", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(options.order.subtotal_cents))]),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Delivery", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(options.order.delivery_fee_cents))]),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Total", weight: FontWeight.bold)), Text(child: formatMoney(options.order.total_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold)])
    ]))
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "order", type: Order, required: true)],
)
